id: \bWhat do I do? I have to get the Poké Flute back. Everyone is really concerned about the Snorlax blocking the way too.
en: \bWhat do I do? I have to get the Poké Flute back.  Everyone is really concerned about the Snorlax blocking the way too.
it: \bChe faccio? Devo recuperare il Poké Flauto. E tutti sono davvero preoccupati per lo Snorlax che blocca la strada.

id: \bPerhaps you could help? You need to pass don't you? If you get the flute Snorlax might wake up. You can even keep the flute. Better than her having it.
en: \bPerhaps you could help? You need to pass don't you? If you get the flute Snorlax might wake up. You can even keep the flute. Better than her having it.
it: \bForse potresti aiutarmi? Devi passare di lì, no? Se recuperi il flauto, Snorlax potrebbe svegliarsi. Puoi anche tenerti il flauto. Meglio che ce l'abbia tu che lei.

id: \bYou got the Poké Flute back! Please keep it. Better than the princess stealing it again.
en: \bYou got the Poké Flute back! Please keep it. Better than the princess stealing it again.
it: \bHai recuperato il Poké Flauto! Tienilo pure. Meglio così che lasciare che la principessa lo rubi di nuovo.

id: \bI have this Nest Ball I don't know what to do with. I wish someone would take it off my hands.
en: \bI have this Nest Ball I don't know what to do with. I wish someone would take it off my hands.
it: \bHo questa Minor Ball e non so cosa farci. Vorrei che qualcuno me la togliesse di mano.

id: \rI worry about the master. He is always being taken advantage of by the owner of the Parfum Palace.
en: \rI worry about the master. He is always being taken advantage of by the owner of the Parfum Palace.
it: \rSono preoccupata per il padrone. La proprietaria del Palazzo Parfum se ne approfitta sempre.

id: \bMy daughter really likes her personal space. I hope she gets over it soon.
en: \bMy daughter really likes her personal space. I hope she gets over it soon.
it: \bA mia figlia piace davvero tanto avere i suoi spazi. Spero che le passi presto.

id: \rWhy are you in my room?! Get out!!!
en: \rWhy are you in my room?! Get out!!!
it: \rChe ci fai in camera mia?! Fuori!!!
